LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: The Heart of Aspiration
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: The Heart of Aspiration (T-09-77) is an equippable TETH Tool Abnormality.\nBorrowing the racing heart grants surge-speed and combat ferocity, yet failing to spill enemy blood within 60 seconds—or returning it peacefully too soon—drives its wearer berserk.
